Multiplying a vector by zero yields a zero vector rather than a scalar, and vector division is undefined in vector algebra. Therefore, both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.

चरण 1: सदिश का अदिश शून्य से गुणन का विश्लेषण
जब किसी सदिश \(\mathbf{A}\) को वास्तविक संख्या \(\lambda = 0\) से गुणा किया जाता है, तो सदिश बीजगणित में परिणाम एक शून्य सदिश (नल वेक्टर) \(\mathbf{0}\) के रूप में परिभाषित होता है, अर्थात \(0 \times \mathbf{A} = \mathbf{0}\)। शून्य सदिश का परिमाण शून्य और दिशा अनिर्धारित या स्वेच्छ होती है; यह अनिवार्य रूप से एक सदिश राशि है, न कि कोई साधारण अदिश शून्य। अतः यह दावा कि परिणाम अदिश शून्य होता है, गलत है।

चरण 2: सदिश विभाजन का विश्लेषण
सदिश बीजगणित में योग, घटाव, अदिश गुणन, बिंदु गुणन (डॉट उत्पाद), और वज्र गुणन (क्रॉस उत्पाद) जैसी संक्रियाएँ सुव्यवस्थित रूप से परिभाषित हैं। किंतु एक सदिश को दूसरे सदिश से विभाजित करने (अर्थात \(\mathbf{A}/\mathbf{B}\)) की कोई संक्रिया परिभाषित नहीं है। इसका कारण यह है कि ऐसा कोई अद्वितीय सदिश \(\mathbf{C}\) संभव नहीं है जो \(\mathbf{B} \times \mathbf{C} = \mathbf{A}\) या \(\mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{C} = |\mathbf{A}|\) को संतुष्ट कर सके। सदिशों को केवल शून्येतर अदिशों से विभाजित किया जा सकता है। अतः सदिश विभाजन का दावा गलत है।

निष्कर्ष
सदिश को शून्य से गुणा करने पर एक शून्य सदिश प्राप्त होता है न कि अदिश, और सदिश बीजगणित में सदिशों का विभाजन अपरिभाषित है। अतः, कथन I और कथन II दोनों गलत हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q03 - Independence of perpendicular components in projectile motion

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In projectile motion under gravity with negligible air resistance, the horizontal motion and vertical motion take place independently of each other.

Statement II: The horizontal component of the velocity of a projectile decreases continuously as the projectile ascends toward its maximum height.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: नगण्य वायु प्रतिरोध के साथ गुरुत्वाकर्षण के अधीन प्रक्षेप्य गति में, क्षैतिज गति और ऊर्ध्वाधर गति एक दूसरे से पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र होकर घटित होती हैं।

कथन II: जैसे-जैसे प्रक्षेप्य अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई की ओर ऊपर चढ़ता है, उसके वेग का क्षैतिज घटक लगातार घटता जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Analysis of perpendicular motions in projectile motion
Galileo's principle of superposition states that two-dimensional motion can be analyzed as two separate, simultaneous one-dimensional motions along mutually perpendicular axes. In standard projectile motion with negligible air resistance, gravity acts purely along the downward vertical direction (\(a_y = -g\)) and there is zero acceleration along the horizontal direction (\(a_x = 0\)). Because motion along perpendicular axes does not affect each other, horizontal and vertical motions are independent. Thus, the first proposition is valid.

Step 2: Analysis of the horizontal velocity component
The horizontal component of velocity is governed by \(v_x(t) = u_x + a_x t\). Since the horizontal acceleration \(a_x = 0\), the horizontal velocity remains constant throughout the entire trajectory: \(v_x = u_x = u \cos\theta\). It does not decrease during the ascent; only the vertical velocity component \(v_y = u \sin\theta - gt\) decreases during ascent. Therefore, the second proposition is invalid.

Conclusion
Horizontal and vertical motions in projectile motion are mutually independent, but the horizontal velocity component remains constant rather than decreasing. Therefore, Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.

चरण 1: प्रक्षेप्य गति में लंबवत गतियों का विश्लेषण
गैलीलियो का अध्यारोपण सिद्धांत बताता है कि द्विविमीय गति का विश्लेषण दो परस्पर लंबवत अक्षों के अनुदिश दो पृथक और एक साथ होने वाली एकविमीय गतियों के रूप में किया जा सकता है। नगण्य वायु प्रतिरोध वाली मानक प्रक्षेप्य गति में, गुरुत्वाकर्षण केवल नीचे की ऊर्ध्वाधर दिशा में कार्य करता है (\(a_y = -g\)) और क्षैतिज दिशा में कोई त्वरण नहीं होता (\(a_x = 0\))। चूंकि लंबवत अक्षों के अनुदिश गतियाँ एक-दूसरे को प्रभावित नहीं करती हैं, इसलिए क्षैतिज और ऊर्ध्वाधर गतियाँ स्वतंत्र होती हैं। अतः पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: क्षैतिज वेग घटक का विश्लेषण
वेग का क्षैतिज घटक समीकरण \(v_x(t) = u_x + a_x t\) द्वारा निर्धारित होता है। चूंकि क्षैतिज त्वरण \(a_x = 0\) है, क्षैतिज वेग पूरे प्रक्षेप-पथ में स्थिर रहता है: \(v_x = u_x = u \cos\theta\)। ऊपर चढ़ते समय यह घटता नहीं है; केवल ऊर्ध्वाधर वेग घटक \(v_y = u \sin\theta - gt\) ही ऊपर चढ़ते समय घटता है। अतः दूसरा कथन गलत है।

निष्कर्ष
प्रक्षेप्य गति में क्षैतिज और ऊर्ध्वाधर गतियाँ परस्पर स्वतंत्र होती हैं, किंतु वेग का क्षैतिज घटक घटने के बजाय स्थिर रहता है। अतः, कथन I सही है लेकिन कथन II गलत है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q04 - Velocity and acceleration at the apex of projectile motion

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: At the apex of a projectile's parabolic path, both the velocity and acceleration of the projectile are zero.

Statement II: At the apex of a projectile's parabolic path, the velocity vector is strictly perpendicular to the acceleration vector.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: प्रक्षेप्य के परवलयाकार पथ के शीर्ष (उच्चतम बिंदु) पर, प्रक्षेप्य का वेग और त्वरण दोनों शून्य होते हैं।

कथन II: प्रक्षेप्य के परवलयाकार पथ के शीर्ष (उच्चतम बिंदु) पर, वेग सदिश त्वरण सदिश के पूर्णतः लंबवत होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of velocity and acceleration at maximum height
At the highest point (apex) of projectile motion, the vertical velocity component momentarily vanishes: \(v_y = 0\). However, the horizontal velocity component remains unchanged: \(v_x = u \cos heta eq 0\) (for any projection angle \( heta eq 90^\circ\)). Thus the net velocity at the peak is non-zero: \(\mathbf{v}_{ ext{apex}} = u \cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}\). Furthermore, the acceleration remains constant throughout the trajectory, equal to the downward acceleration due to gravity: \(\mathbf{a} = -g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} eq \mathbf{0}\). Therefore, neither velocity nor acceleration is zero at the apex, making the first proposition invalid.

Step 2: Directional relationship between velocity and acceleration vectors
At the apex, the velocity is directed purely horizontally along the positive \(x\)-direction (\(\mathbf{v} = u\cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)), while the acceleration is directed purely vertically downward along the negative \(y\)-direction (\(\mathbf{a} = -g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)). Computing their scalar product:
\[ \mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = (u \cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}) \cdot (-g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}}) = 0 \]
Since their dot product is zero, the angle between the velocity vector and the acceleration vector is exactly \(90^\circ\). Thus, they are strictly perpendicular, making the second proposition valid.

Conclusion
The projectile retains a non-zero horizontal velocity and non-zero downward acceleration at the apex, and these two vectors are perpendicular to each other. Therefore, Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

चरण 1: अधिकतम ऊँचाई पर वेग और त्वरण का मूल्यांकन
प्रक्षेप्य गति के उच्चतम बिंदु (शीर्ष) पर, ऊर्ध्वाधर वेग घटक क्षण भर के लिए शून्य हो जाता है: \(v_y = 0\)। किंतु क्षैतिज वेग घटक अपरिवर्तित रहता है: \(v_x = u \cos heta eq 0\) (किसी भी प्रक्षेपण कोण \( heta eq 90^\circ\) के लिए)। अतः शीर्ष पर कुल वेग शून्येतर होता है: \(\mathbf{v}_{ ext{apex}} = u \cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)। इसके अतिरिक्त, पूरे प्रक्षेप-पथ में त्वरण स्थिर रहता है, जो नीचे की ओर कार्य करने वाले गुरुत्वीय त्वरण के बराबर होता है: \(\mathbf{a} = -g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} eq \mathbf{0}\)। अतः शीर्ष पर न तो वेग शून्य होता है और न ही त्वरण। इस प्रकार पहला कथन गलत है।

चरण 2: वेग और त्वरण सदिशों के बीच दिशात्मक संबंध
शीर्ष पर, वेग विशुद्ध रूप से धनात्मक \(x\)-दिशा में क्षैतिज होता है (\(\mathbf{v} = u\cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)), जबकि त्वरण विशुद्ध रूप से ऋणात्मक \(y\)-दिशा में ऊर्ध्वाधर नीचे की ओर होता है (\(\mathbf{a} = -g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}}\))। इनका अदिश गुणनफल ज्ञात करने पर:
\[ \mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = (u \cos heta\,\hat{\mathbf{i}}) \cdot (-g\,\hat{\mathbf{j}}) = 0 \]
चूंकि इनका डॉट उत्पाद शून्य है, अतः वेग सदिश और त्वरण सदिश के बीच का कोण ठीक \(90^\circ\) होता है। इस प्रकार वे परस्पर लंबवत होते हैं, जिससे दूसरा कथन सही सिद्ध होता है।

निष्कर्ष
प्रक्षेप्य के शीर्ष पर क्षैतिज वेग और नीचे की ओर त्वरण दोनों शून्येतर होते हैं, और ये दोनों सदिश परस्पर लंबवत होते हैं। अतः, कथन I गलत है लेकिन कथन II सही है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q05 - Properties of unit vectors and planar vector resolution

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: A unit vector has a magnitude equal to unity, carries no physical units or dimensions, and serves specifically to specify a spatial direction.

Statement II: Any arbitrary vector in a two-dimensional Cartesian plane can be uniquely resolved into a linear combination of two mutually orthogonal base unit vectors.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: एक एकांक सदिश का परिमाण इकाई (एक) होता है, इसका कोई भौतिक मात्रक या विमा नहीं होती है, और यह विशेष रूप से किसी स्थानिक दिशा को निर्दिष्ट करने के काम आता है।

कथन II: एक द्विविमीय कार्तीय तल में किसी भी स्वेच्छ सदिश को दो परस्पर लंबवत आधार एकांक सदिशों के रैखिक संयोजन में विशिष्ट रूप से वियोजित किया जा सकता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Characterization of unit vectors
A unit vector along the direction of a vector \(\mathbf{A}\) is defined by the relation \(\hat{\mathbf{n}} = \frac{\mathbf{A}}{|\mathbf{A}|}\). Since both the numerator and the denominator carry identical physical units and dimensions, their ratio is a dimensionless, unitless entity whose absolute magnitude is identically \(|\hat{\mathbf{n}}| = 1\). Its sole mathematical and physical function is to assign a directional orientation. Hence, the first proposition is valid.

Step 2: Planar resolution of vectors
In a Cartesian coordinate plane with orthogonal axes \(x\) and \(y\), unit vectors \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) point along the positive axes. According to the theorem of vector resolution, any coplanar vector \(\mathbf{A}\) can be uniquely expressed as \(\mathbf{A} = A_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + A_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), where the scalar projections are uniquely determined by \(A_x = |\mathbf{A}|\cos\theta\) and \(A_y = |\mathbf{A}|\sin\theta\). Hence, the second proposition is valid.

Conclusion
Both propositions correctly express fundamental principles regarding unit vectors and Cartesian vector resolution. Therefore, both Statement I and Statement II are correct.

चरण 1: एकांक सदिशों का लक्षण-वर्णन
किसी सदिश \(\mathbf{A}\) की दिशा में एकांक सदिश संबंध \(\hat{\mathbf{n}} = \frac{\mathbf{A}}{|\mathbf{A}|}\) द्वारा परिभाषित होता है। चूंकि अंश और हर दोनों में समान भौतिक मात्रक और विमाएँ होती हैं, इसलिए उनका अनुपात एक विमाहीन, मात्रकहीन राशि होती है जिसका निरपेक्ष परिमाण सदैव \(|\hat{\mathbf{n}}| = 1\) होता है। इसका एकमात्र गणितीय और भौतिक कार्य एक दिशात्मक अभिविन्यास निर्दिष्ट करना है। अतः पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: सदिशों का समतलीय वियोजन
लंबवत \(x\) और \(y\) अक्षों वाले कार्तीय निर्देशांक तल में, एकांक सदिश \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) और \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) धनात्मक अक्षों के अनुदिश होते हैं। सदिश वियोजन के प्रमेय के अनुसार, किसी भी समतलीय सदिश \(\mathbf{A}\) को \(\mathbf{A} = A_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + A_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) के रूप में विशिष्ट रूप से व्यक्त किया जा सकता है, जहाँ अदिश घटक \(A_x = |\mathbf{A}|\cos\theta\) और \(A_y = |\mathbf{A}|\sin\theta\) द्वारा विशिष्ट रूप से निर्धारित होते हैं। अतः दूसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
दोनों कथन एकांक सदिशों और कार्तीय सदिश वियोजन से संबंधित मूलभूत सिद्धांतों को सही ढंग से व्यक्त करते हैं। अतः, कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q06 - Acceleration characteristics in uniform circular motion

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In uniform circular motion, the acceleration of the revolving particle is zero because the speed of the particle remains constant.

Statement II: In uniform circular motion, the acceleration vector of the particle remains constant in both magnitude and direction throughout the trajectory.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, परिक्रमा कर रहे कण का त्वरण शून्य होता है क्योंकि कण की चाल स्थिर रहती है।

कथन II: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, कण का त्वरण सदिश पूरे प्रक्षेप-पथ में परिमाण और दिशा दोनों में स्थिर रहता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of acceleration existence in uniform circular motion
Acceleration is defined as the time rate of change of velocity: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt}\). While the scalar speed \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) is constant in uniform circular motion, the direction of the velocity vector is continuously tangent to the circle and therefore changes at every instant. This continuous redirection of velocity requires a non-zero centripetal acceleration of magnitude \(a_c = \frac{v^2}{R} = \omega^2 R\). Because the acceleration is non-zero, the first proposition is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of the constancy of the acceleration vector
For any vector to be constant, both its magnitude and its spatial direction must remain invariant over time. Although the magnitude of centripetal acceleration \(|\mathbf{a}_c| = \frac{v^2}{R}\) is constant, its direction is radially inward toward the center of the circle. As the particle travels around the circle, the inward radial direction continuously rotates in space. Since its direction changes continuously, the acceleration vector \(\mathbf{a}_c\) is not constant. Therefore, the second proposition is incorrect.

Conclusion
Uniform circular motion involves a non-zero acceleration whose vector direction changes continuously with time. Therefore, both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.

चरण 1: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में त्वरण के अस्तित्व का मूल्यांकन
त्वरण को वेग के परिवर्तन की समय दर के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt}\)। यद्यपि एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में अदिश चाल \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) स्थिर रहती है, किंतु वेग सदिश की दिशा वृत्त के स्पर्शरेखीय होने के कारण प्रत्येक क्षण बदलती रहती है। वेग की दिशा में इस निरंतर परिवर्तन के लिए एक शून्येतर अभिकेन्द्रीय त्वरण की आवश्यकता होती है जिसका परिमाण \(a_c = \frac{v^2}{R} = \omega^2 R\) होता है। चूंकि त्वरण शून्येतर होता है, अतः पहला कथन गलत है।

चरण 2: त्वरण सदिश की स्थिरता का मूल्यांकन
किसी भी सदिश के स्थिर होने के लिए, उसका परिमाण और उसकी स्थानिक दिशा दोनों समय के साथ अपरिवर्तित रहने चाहिए। यद्यपि अभिकेन्द्रीय त्वरण का परिमाण \(|\mathbf{a}_c| = \frac{v^2}{R}\) स्थिर रहता है, किंतु इसकी दिशा सदैव वृत्त के केंद्र की ओर त्रिज्यीय रूप से अंतर्मुखी होती है। जैसे-जैसे कण वृत्त पर गति करता है, अंतर्मुखी त्रिज्यीय दिशा अंतरिक्ष में लगातार घूमती रहती है। चूंकि इसकी दिशा लगातार बदलती रहती है, इसलिए त्वरण सदिश \(\mathbf{a}_c\) स्थिर नहीं होता है। अतः दूसरा कथन गलत है।

निष्कर्ष
एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में एक शून्येतर त्वरण उपस्थित होता है जिसकी सदिश दिशा समय के साथ निरंतर बदलती रहती है। अतः, कथन I और कथन II दोनों गलत हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q07 - Range and maximum height for complementary projection angles

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: For a projectile launched with a given initial speed \(u\) on level ground, the horizontal range is identical for complementary angles of projection \(\theta\) and \((90^\circ - \theta)\).

Statement II: For a projectile launched with a given initial speed \(u\) on level ground, the maximum vertical height achieved is also identical for complementary angles of projection \(\theta\) and \((90^\circ - \theta)\).

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: समतल धरातल पर दी गई प्रारंभिक चाल \(u\) से प्रक्षेपित किए गए प्रक्षेप्य के लिए, पूरक प्रक्षेपण कोणों \(\theta\) और \((90^\circ - \theta)\) के लिए क्षैतिज परास एकसमान होता है।

कथन II: समतल धरातल पर दी गई प्रारंभिक चाल \(u\) से प्रक्षेपित किए गए प्रक्षेप्य के लिए, प्राप्त की गई अधिकतम ऊर्ध्वाधर ऊँचाई भी पूरक प्रक्षेपण कोणों \(\theta\) और \((90^\circ - \theta)\) के लिए एकसमान होती है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Formula and evaluation of horizontal range
The horizontal range on a flat horizontal plane is given by the formula:
\[ R(\theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g} \]
Substituting the complementary angle \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta\):
\[ R(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin[2(90^\circ - \theta)]}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin(180^\circ - 2\theta)}{g} \]
Using the trigonometric identity \(\sin(180^\circ - x) = \sin(x)\), we find:
\[ R(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g} = R(\theta) \]
Thus, the horizontal ranges are identical for complementary angles. This confirms that the first proposition is valid.

Step 2: Formula and evaluation of maximum height
The maximum height reached by the projectile is given by:
\[ H(\theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g} \]
Evaluating for the complementary angle \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta\):
\[ H(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin^2(90^\circ - \theta)}{2g} = \frac{u^2 \cos^2\theta}{2g} \]
Comparing the two expressions:
\[ \frac{H(\theta)}{H(90^\circ - \theta)} = \frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta} = \tan^2\theta \]
These heights are equal if and only if \(\tan^2\theta = 1\) (i.e., \(\theta = 45^\circ\), where the two angles coincide). For distinct complementary angles (such as \(30^\circ\) and \(60^\circ\)), the heights are distinctly different (\(H_{60^\circ} = 3 H_{30^\circ}\)). Therefore, maximum height is not identical for complementary angles, making the second proposition invalid.

Conclusion
Complementary projection angles produce identical horizontal ranges, but distinctly different maximum heights. Therefore, Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.

चरण 1: क्षैतिज परास का सूत्र और मूल्यांकन
समतल क्षैतिज तल पर क्षैतिज परास का सूत्र निम्न है:
\[ R(\theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g} \]
पूरक कोण \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta\) प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:
\[ R(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin[2(90^\circ - \theta)]}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin(180^\circ - 2\theta)}{g} \]
त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिका \(\sin(180^\circ - x) = \sin(x)\) का उपयोग करने पर:
\[ R(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g} = R(\theta) \]
अतः पूरक कोणों के लिए क्षैतिज परास समान होते हैं। यह पुष्टि करता है कि पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: अधिकतम ऊँचाई का सूत्र और मूल्यांकन
प्रक्षेप्य द्वारा प्राप्त अधिकतम ऊँचाई निम्न सूत्र द्वारा दी जाती है:
\[ H(\theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g} \]
पूरक कोण \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta\) के लिए मान निकालने पर:
\[ H(90^\circ - \theta) = \frac{u^2 \sin^2(90^\circ - \theta)}{2g} = \frac{u^2 \cos^2\theta}{2g} \]
दोनों व्यंजकों की तुलना करने पर:
\[ \frac{H(\theta)}{H(90^\circ - \theta)} = \frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta} = \tan^2\theta \]
ये ऊँचाईयाँ केवल और केवल तभी समान होती हैं जब \(\tan^2\theta = 1\) (अर्थात \(\theta = 45^\circ\), जहाँ दोनों कोण एक ही होते हैं)। भिन्न पूरक कोणों (जैसे \(30^\circ\) और \(60^\circ\)) के लिए, ऊँचाईयाँ स्पष्ट रूप से भिन्न होती हैं (\(H_{60^\circ} = 3 H_{30^\circ}\))। अतः पूरक कोणों के लिए अधिकतम ऊँचाई समान नहीं होती है, जिससे दूसरा कथन गलत सिद्ध होता है।

निष्कर्ष
पूरक प्रक्षेपण कोण समान क्षैतिज परास उत्पन्न करते हैं, किंतु स्पष्ट रूप से भिन्न अधिकतम ऊँचाईयाँ उत्पन्न करते हैं। अतः, कथन I सही है लेकिन कथन II गलत है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT_Q08 - Total acceleration components in non-uniform circular motion

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: When a particle travels along a circular path with continuously increasing speed, its total acceleration vector is directed purely toward the center of the circle.

Statement II: In non-uniform circular motion, the net acceleration vector is the vector sum of a centripetal acceleration directed radially inward and a tangential acceleration oriented along the tangent.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: जब कोई कण लगातार बढ़ती हुई चाल से एक वृत्ताकार पथ पर गति करता है, तो उसका कुल त्वरण सदिश विशुद्ध रूप से वृत्त के केंद्र की ओर निर्देशित होता है।

कथन II: असमान वृत्तीय गति में, कुल त्वरण सदिश त्रिज्यीय रूप से अंदर की ओर निर्देशित अभिकेन्द्रीय त्वरण और स्पर्शरेखा के अनुदिश अभिविन्यस्त स्पर्शरेखीय त्वरण का सदिश योग होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Identification of acceleration components in non-uniform circular motion
When the speed of a particle moving in a circle changes over time, its velocity vector changes both in direction and in magnitude. Consequently, the total acceleration \(\mathbf{a}\) has two orthogonal components:
1. Centripetal (radial) acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}_c = -\frac{v^2}{R}\,\hat{\mathbf{r}}\), directed radially inward toward the center, which accounts for the changing direction of velocity.
2. Tangential acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}_t = \frac{dv}{dt}\,\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\), directed tangentially along the instantaneous velocity, which accounts for the changing magnitude of speed.

Step 2: Direction of total acceleration vector
The net acceleration vector is given by the vector sum \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\). The angle \(\phi\) between the net acceleration vector and the radial direction toward the center satisfies:
\[ \tan\phi = \frac{|\mathbf{a}_t|}{|\mathbf{a}_c|} = \frac{|dv/dt|}{v^2/R} \]
Since the speed is continuously increasing, \(\frac{dv}{dt} > 0\), meaning \(|\mathbf{a}_t| \neq 0\) and hence \(\phi > 0\). The total acceleration vector is tilted forward from the radius toward the direction of motion, and therefore does NOT point purely toward the center. This shows that the first proposition is invalid.

Step 3: Verification of vector decomposition
Because radial and tangential directions form a complete orthogonal basis for circular kinematics, the total acceleration is precisely the vector sum of the centripetal and tangential accelerations: \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\) with magnitude \(|\mathbf{a}| = \sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\). This confirms that the second proposition is valid.

Conclusion
In non-uniform circular motion with increasing speed, the total acceleration is the vector resultant of radial and tangential components and does not point purely toward the center. Therefore, Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

चरण 1: असमान वृत्तीय गति में त्वरण घटकों की पहचान
जब किसी वृत्त में गतिमान कण की चाल समय के साथ बदलती है, तो उसका वेग सदिश दिशा और परिमाण दोनों में बदलता है। परिणामस्वरूप, कुल त्वरण \(\mathbf{a}\) के दो लंबवत घटक होते हैं:
1. अभिकेन्द्रीय (त्रिज्यीय) त्वरण: \(\mathbf{a}_c = -\frac{v^2}{R}\,\hat{\mathbf{r}}\), जो केंद्र की ओर त्रिज्यीय रूप से अंतर्मुखी होता है, और वेग की बदलती दिशा के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है।
2. स्पर्शरेखीय त्वरण: \(\mathbf{a}_t = \frac{dv}{dt}\,\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\), जो तात्कालिक वेग के अनुदिश स्पर्शरेखीय होता है, और चाल के बदलते परिमाण के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है।

चरण 2: कुल त्वरण सदिश की दिशा
कुल त्वरण सदिश सदिश योग \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\) द्वारा दिया जाता है। कुल त्वरण सदिश और केंद्र की ओर त्रिज्यीय दिशा के बीच का कोण \(\phi\) निम्नलिखित को संतुष्ट करता है:
\[ \tan\phi = \frac{|\mathbf{a}_t|}{|\mathbf{a}_c|} = \frac{|dv/dt|}{v^2/R} \]
चूंकि चाल लगातार बढ़ रही है, अतः \(\frac{dv}{dt} > 0\) है, जिसका अर्थ है \(|\mathbf{a}_t| \neq 0\) और इसलिए \(\phi > 0\)। कुल त्वरण सदिश त्रिज्या से गति की दिशा की ओर आगे की ओर झुका होता है, और इसलिए यह विशुद्ध रूप से केंद्र की ओर इंगित नहीं करता है। यह दर्शाता है कि पहला कथन गलत है।

चरण 3: सदिश वियोजन का सत्यापन
चूंकि त्रिज्यीय और स्पर्शरेखीय दिशाएँ वृत्तीय शुद्धगतिकी के लिए एक पूर्ण लंबकोणीय आधार बनाती हैं, इसलिए कुल त्वरण अभिकेन्द्रीय और स्पर्शरेखीय त्वरणों का सटीक सदिश योग होता है: \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\), जिसका परिमाण \(|\mathbf{a}| = \sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\) होता है। यह पुष्टि करता है कि दूसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
बढ़ती चाल वाली असमान वृत्तीय गति में, कुल त्वरण त्रिज्यीय और स्पर्शरेखीय घटकों का परिणामी सदिश होता है और यह केवल केंद्र की ओर इंगित नहीं करता है। अतः, कथन I गलत है लेकिन कथन II सही है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT3_Q01 - Fundamental properties of scalars and vectors

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: Scalars can be manipulated using ordinary rules of algebra, provided addition and subtraction are performed only between quantities having identical physical dimensions and units.

Statement II: A vector quantity is specified by its magnitude and spatial direction, and it must obey the triangle or parallelogram law of vector addition.

Statement III: Multiplying a vector by a negative real number changes its magnitude by the absolute value of that number and reverses its direction by 180 degrees.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: अदिश राशियों को बीजगणित के सामान्य नियमों द्वारा हल किया जा सकता है, बशर्ते कि योग और घटाव केवल समान भौतिक विमाओं और मात्रकों वाली राशियों के बीच किया जाए।

कथन II: एक सदिश राशि को उसके परिमाण और स्थानिक दिशा द्वारा निर्दिष्ट किया जाता है, और इसे सदिश योग के त्रिभुज अथवा समांतर चतुर्भुज नियम का अनिवार्यतः पालन करना चाहिए।

कथन III: किसी सदिश को ऋणात्मक वास्तविक संख्या से गुणा करने पर उसका परिमाण उस संख्या के निरपेक्ष मान के अनुसार बदल जाता है और उसकी दिशा 180 अंश उलट जाती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the physical rules governing scalars
Scalar quantities are fully specified by a single real number accompanied by a proper physical unit. Ordinary algebraic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) apply directly to scalars. However, dimensional homogeneity requires that addition and subtraction are physically valid only if both scalars have the exact same dimensions and units (for instance, one cannot add a length to a temperature). Multiplication and division of scalars with different units, conversely, remain valid (e.g., mass divided by volume yields density). Thus, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of the defining criteria of vectors
Having both magnitude and direction is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a quantity to be a vector (e.g., electric current has magnitude and direction but does not add vectorially). To be a true physical vector, the quantity must additionally satisfy the triangle law or the parallelogram law of vector addition. Thus, the second statement is correct.

Step 3: Evaluation of scalar multiplication by a negative real number
When a vector \(\mathbf{A}\) is multiplied by a negative real scalar \(-\lambda\) (where \(\lambda > 0\)), the resulting vector has magnitude \(|-\lambda \mathbf{A}| = \lambda |\mathbf{A}|\) and points in the direction exactly opposite to \(\mathbf{A}\), which corresponds to a spatial direction reversal of \(180^\circ\). Thus, the third statement is correct.

Conclusion
All three propositions accurately reflect the fundamental principles of scalars and vectors. Therefore, Statement I, Statement II and Statement III are correct.

चरण 1: अदिश राशियों को नियंत्रित करने वाले भौतिक नियमों का मूल्यांकन
अदिश राशियों को उचित भौतिक मात्रक के साथ एक एकल वास्तविक संख्या द्वारा पूरी तरह निर्दिष्ट किया जाता है। सामान्य बीजगणितीय संक्रियाएं (योग, घटाव, गुणा और भाग) अदिशों पर सीधे लागू होती हैं। किंतु विमीय समांगता के नियम के अनुसार योग और घटाव केवल तभी भौतिक रूप से मान्य होते हैं जब दोनों अदिशों की विमाएं और मात्रक समान हों (उदाहरण के लिए, लंबाई को तापमान में नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता)। इसके विपरीत, विभिन्न मात्रकों वाले अदिशों का गुणा और भाग मान्य रहता है (जैसे, द्रव्यमान को आयतन से भाग देने पर घनत्व प्राप्त होता है)। अतः पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: सदिशों के निर्णायक मानदंडों का मूल्यांकन
किसी राशि के सदिश होने के लिए केवल परिमाण और दिशा होना पर्याप्त नहीं है (उदाहरणार्थ, विद्युत धारा में परिमाण और दिशा दोनों होते हैं किंतु यह सदिश योग के नियमों का पालन नहीं करती)। वास्तविक भौतिक सदिश होने के लिए, राशि को सदिश योग के त्रिभुज नियम अथवा समांतर चतुर्भुज नियम का भी अनिवार्यतः पालन करना चाहिए। अतः दूसरा कथन सही है।

चरण 3: ऋणात्मक वास्तविक संख्या द्वारा सदिश गुणन का मूल्यांकन
जब किसी सदिश \(\mathbf{A}\) को ऋणात्मक वास्तविक अदिश \(-\lambda\) (जहाँ \(\lambda > 0\)) से गुणा किया जाता है, तो परिणामी सदिश का परिमाण \(|-\lambda \mathbf{A}| = \lambda |\mathbf{A}|\) होता है और इसकी दिशा \(\mathbf{A}\) के ठीक विपरीत होती है, जो \(180^\circ\) दिशा उत्क्रमण के अनुरूप है। अतः तीसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
तीनों कथन अदिशों और सदिशों के मूलभूत सिद्धांतों को सटीक रूप से व्यक्त करते हैं। अतः, कथन I, कथन II और कथन III सही हैं।

answer.text: Statement I, Statement II and Statement III are correct.
Statement I and Statement II only are correct.
Statement II and Statement III only are correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT3_Q02 - Two dimensional motion with constant acceleration

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: Motion of an object in a plane with constant acceleration can be treated as two separate, simultaneous one-dimensional motions with constant acceleration along two perpendicular directions.

Statement II: If the acceleration component along the x-direction is zero, the position coordinate x of the particle varies quadratically with time.

Statement III: The kinematic position equation \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_0 + \mathbf{v}_0 t + \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}t^2\) is applicable only when the acceleration vector \(\mathbf{a}\) is strictly constant in both magnitude and direction.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: नियत त्वरण के साथ किसी तल में किसी पिंड की गति को दो परस्पर लंबवत दिशाओं के अनुदिश नियत त्वरण वाली दो पृथक और एक साथ होने वाली एकविमीय गतियों के रूप में माना जा सकता है।

कथन II: यदि x-दिशा के अनुदिश त्वरण घटक शून्य है, तो कण का स्थिति निर्देशांक x समय के साथ द्विघातीय रूप से परिवर्तित होता है।

कथन III: शुद्धगतिकीय स्थिति समीकरण \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_0 + \mathbf{v}_0 t + \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}t^2\) केवल तभी लागू होता है जब त्वरण सदिश \(\mathbf{a}\) परिमाण और दिशा दोनों में पूर्णतः स्थिर हो।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of Cartesian independence of perpendicular axes
In two dimensions, vector equations decompose along orthogonal axes into \(x(t) = x_0 + v_{0x}t + \frac{1}{2}a_x t^2\) and \(y(t) = y_0 + v_{0y}t + \frac{1}{2}a_y t^2\). Because the orthogonal coordinates and their respective accelerations act independently without cross-coupling terms, planar motion with constant acceleration is strictly equivalent to two independent, simultaneous one-dimensional motions. Thus, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of position dependence when acceleration is zero
When the acceleration along the \(x\)-direction is identically zero (\(a_x = 0\)), the position along the \(x\)-axis evolves according to \(x(t) = x_0 + v_{0x}t\). This is a strictly linear function of time, not quadratic. A quadratic dependence requires a non-zero constant acceleration \(a_x \neq 0\). Thus, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Domain of validity of kinematic equations
The standard kinematic relations \(\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{v}_0 + \mathbf{a}t\) and \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_0 + \mathbf{v}_0 t + \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}t^2\) are derived by integrating a constant acceleration vector. If either the magnitude or the direction of \(\mathbf{a}\) changes with time (such as in uniform circular motion where direction changes), these equations cease to apply and calculus must be used instead. Thus, the third statement is correct.

Conclusion
The first and third statements are physically valid, while the second statement is invalid. Therefore, Statement I and Statement III only are correct.

चरण 1: लंबवत अक्षों की कार्तीय स्वतंत्रता का मूल्यांकन
द्विविमा में, सदिश समीकरण लांबिक अक्षों के अनुदिश \(x(t) = x_0 + v_{0x}t + \frac{1}{2}a_x t^2\) और \(y(t) = y_0 + v_{0y}t + \frac{1}{2}a_y t^2\) में वियोजित होते हैं। चूंकि लांबिक निर्देशांक और उनके संबंधित त्वरण बिना किसी परस्पर युग्मन के स्वतंत्र रूप से कार्य करते हैं, इसलिए नियत त्वरण के साथ समतलीय गति दो स्वतंत्र, समकालिक एकविमीय गतियों के बिल्कुल समतुल्य होती है। अतः पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: शून्य त्वरण होने पर स्थिति की समय पर निर्भरता का मूल्यांकन
जब \(x\)-दिशा के अनुदिश त्वरण शून्य होता है (\(a_x = 0\)), तो \(x\)-अक्ष के अनुदिश स्थिति \(x(t) = x_0 + v_{0x}t\) के अनुसार बदलती है। यह समय का एक रैखिक फलन है, न कि द्विघातीय। द्विघातीय निर्भरता के लिए एक शून्येतर नियत त्वरण \(a_x \neq 0\) की आवश्यकता होती है। अतः दूसरा कथन गलत है।

चरण 3: शुद्धगतिकीय समीकरणों की वैधता का क्षेत्र
मानक शुद्धगतिकीय संबंध \(\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{v}_0 + \mathbf{a}t\) और \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_0 + \mathbf{v}_0 t + \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}t^2\) एक नियत त्वरण सदिश के समाकलन से प्राप्त होते हैं। यदि समय के साथ \(\mathbf{a}\) का परिमाण अथवा दिशा बदलती है (जैसे एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में दिशा बदलती है), तो ये समीकरण लागू नहीं होते और समाकलन कलन का उपयोग करना पड़ता है। अतः तीसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
पहला और तीसरा कथन भौतिक रूप से सही हैं, जबकि दूसरा कथन गलत है। अतः, केवल कथन I और कथन III सही हैं।

answer.text: Statement I, Statement II and Statement III are correct.
Statement I and Statement III only are correct.
Statement I and Statement II only are correct.
Statement II and Statement III only are correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT3_Q03 - Trajectory flight time and range of a projectile

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: The trajectory of a projectile launched at an angle \(\theta_0\) (\(0^\circ < \theta_0 < 90^\circ\)) under uniform gravity in the absence of air resistance is a parabola.

Statement II: For a projectile launched with a fixed initial speed on level ground, the total time of flight is identical for complementary launch angles \(\theta_0\) and \((90^\circ - \theta_0)\).

Statement III: For a given projection speed on level ground, the horizontal range is maximum when the projection angle \(\theta_0\) is equal to \(45^\circ\).

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: वायु प्रतिरोध की अनुपस्थिति में एकसमान गुरुत्वाकर्षण के अधीन \(\theta_0\) (\(0^\circ < \theta_0 < 90^\circ\)) कोण पर प्रक्षेपित प्रक्षेप्य का प्रक्षेप-पथ एक परवलय होता है।

कथन II: समतल धरातल पर नियत प्रारंभिक चाल से प्रक्षेपित प्रक्षेप्य के लिए, पूरक प्रक्षेपण कोणों \(\theta_0\) और \((90^\circ - \theta_0)\) के लिए कुल उड्डयन काल समान होता है।

कथन III: समतल धरातल पर दी गई प्रक्षेपण चाल के लिए, क्षैतिज परास अधिकतम होता है जब प्रक्षेपण कोण \(\theta_0\) का मान \(45^\circ\) के बराबर होता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of projectile path equation
Eliminating time \(t = \frac{x}{v_0 \cos\theta_0}\) from the vertical position equation \(y = (v_0 \sin\theta_0)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^2\) yields the equation of the trajectory:
\[ y = (\tan\theta_0)x - \frac{g}{2(v_0 \cos\theta_0)^2}x^2 \]
This expression is of the standard mathematical form \(y = ax + bx^2\), which defines a parabola opening downward. Thus, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of time of flight for complementary angles
The total time of flight on level ground is given by:
\[ T_f(\theta_0) = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta_0}{g} \]
Evaluating for the complementary launch angle \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta_0\):
\[ T_f(90^\circ - \theta_0) = \frac{2v_0 \sin(90^\circ - \theta_0)}{g} = \frac{2v_0 \cos\theta_0}{g} \]
The ratio of the two flight times is \(\frac{T_f(\theta_0)}{T_f(90^\circ - \theta_0)} = \tan\theta_0\). These values are equal only when \(\theta_0 = 45^\circ\). For all other distinct complementary angles, the flight times differ (for example, at \(30^\circ\) and \(60^\circ\), the flight time for \(60^\circ\) is \(\sqrt{3}\) times that for \(30^\circ\)). Although the horizontal ranges are identical for complementary angles, the times of flight are not. Thus, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Condition for maximum horizontal range
The horizontal range is given by \(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta_0)}{g}\). For a fixed launch speed \(v_0\), \(R\) is maximized when \(\sin(2\theta_0)\) reaches its maximum possible value of \(1\), which occurs when \(2\theta_0 = 90^\circ\), yielding \(\theta_0 = 45^\circ\). Thus, the third statement is correct.

Conclusion
The trajectory is parabolic and maximum range occurs at \(45^\circ\), but time of flight is not identical for complementary angles. Therefore, Statement I and Statement III only are correct.

चरण 1: प्रक्षेप्य के पथ समीकरण का मूल्यांकन
ऊर्ध्वाधर स्थिति समीकरण \(y = (v_0 \sin\theta_0)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^2\) से समय \(t = \frac{x}{v_0 \cos\theta_0}\) को विलोपित करने पर प्रक्षेप-पथ का समीकरण प्राप्त होता है:
\[ y = (\tan\theta_0)x - \frac{g}{2(v_0 \cos\theta_0)^2}x^2 \]
यह व्यंजक मानक गणितीय रूप \(y = ax + bx^2\) का है, जो नीचे की ओर खुलने वाले परवलय को परिभाषित करता है। अतः पहला कथन सही है।

चरण 2: पूरक कोणों के लिए उड्डयन काल का मूल्यांकन
समतल धरातल पर कुल उड्डयन काल निम्न सूत्र द्वारा दिया जाता है:
\[ T_f(\theta_0) = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta_0}{g} \]
पूरक प्रक्षेपण कोण \(\theta' = 90^\circ - \theta_0\) के लिए मान निकालने पर:
\[ T_f(90^\circ - \theta_0) = \frac{2v_0 \sin(90^\circ - \theta_0)}{g} = \frac{2v_0 \cos\theta_0}{g} \]
दोनों उड्डयन कालों का अनुपात \(\frac{T_f(\theta_0)}{T_f(90^\circ - \theta_0)} = \tan\theta_0\) होता है। ये मान केवल तभी बराबर होते हैं जब \(\theta_0 = 45^\circ\) हो। अन्य सभी पूरक कोणों के लिए उड्डयन काल भिन्न होते हैं (जैसे \(30^\circ\) और \(60^\circ\) के लिए, \(60^\circ\) पर उड्डयन काल \(30^\circ\) की तुलना में \(\sqrt{3}\) गुना होता है)। यद्यपि पूरक कोणों के लिए क्षैतिज परास समान होता है, किंतु उड्डयन काल समान नहीं होता है। अतः दूसरा कथन गलत है।

चरण 3: अधिकतम क्षैतिज परास की शर्त
क्षैतिज परास \(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta_0)}{g}\) द्वारा दिया जाता है। एक निश्चित प्रक्षेपण चाल \(v_0\) के लिए, \(R\) अधिकतम तब होता है जब \(\sin(2\theta_0)\) अपने अधिकतम मान \(1\) तक पहुँचता है, जो \(2\theta_0 = 90^\circ\) अर्थात \(\theta_0 = 45^\circ\) पर प्राप्त होता है। अतः तीसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
प्रक्षेप-पथ परवलयाकार होता है और अधिकतम परास \(45^\circ\) पर प्राप्त होता है, किंतु पूरक कोणों के लिए उड्डयन काल एकसमान नहीं होता। अतः, केवल कथन I और कथन III सही हैं।

answer.text: Statement I and Statement II only are correct.
Statement II and Statement III only are correct.
Statement I and Statement III only are correct.
Statement I, Statement II and Statement III are correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS11_CH03_STATEMENT3_Q04 - Kinematics and dynamics of uniform and non-uniform circular motion

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: In uniform circular motion, the net work done by the centripetal force on the object over any finite displacement along the arc is always non-zero because displacement continuously accumulates.

Statement II: In uniform circular motion, the acceleration vector of the particle averaged over one complete revolution is a non-zero vector directed toward the center of the orbit.

Statement III: In non-uniform circular motion, the magnitude of the total instantaneous acceleration vector is given by \(\sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\), where \(a_c\) is the centripetal acceleration and \(a_t\) is the tangential acceleration.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, चाप के अनुदिश किसी भी सीमित विस्थापन पर वस्तु पर अभिकेन्द्रीय बल द्वारा किया गया कुल कार्य हमेशा शून्येतर होता है क्योंकि विस्थापन लगातार संचित होता रहता है।

कथन II: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, एक पूर्ण परिक्रमण के दौरान औसत निकाला गया कण का त्वरण सदिश एक शून्येतर सदिश होता है जो कक्षा के केंद्र की ओर निर्देशित होता है।

कथन III: असमान वृत्तीय गति में, कुल तात्कालिक त्वरण सदिश का परिमाण \(\sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\) द्वारा दिया जाता है, जहाँ \(a_c\) अभिकेन्द्रीय त्वरण है और \(a_t\) स्पर्शरेखीय त्वरण है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of work done by centripetal force
In uniform circular motion, the centripetal force \(\mathbf{F}_c\) is directed radially inward toward the instantaneous center of curvature, while the infinitesimal displacement \(d\mathbf{r}\) (and instantaneous velocity \(\mathbf{v}\)) is oriented along the tangent to the circle. Because radius and tangent are mutually perpendicular everywhere, the scalar product is identically zero at every instant:
\[ dW = \mathbf{F}_c \cdot d\mathbf{r} = F_c \, ds \cos(90^\circ) = 0 \]
Integrating over any finite segment of the circular path yields total work \(W = \int dW = 0\). The centripetal force does zero work on the particle. Thus, the first statement is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of average acceleration over one full period
Average acceleration over a time interval \(T\) is defined as \(\overline{\mathbf{a}} = \frac{\Delta \mathbf{v}}{T} = \frac{\mathbf{v}(t + T) - \mathbf{v}(t)}{T}\). In uniform circular motion, after completing one full revolution (time period \(T\)), the particle returns to its identical position with an identical speed and an identical velocity direction. Therefore, the change in the velocity vector over one complete cycle is exactly zero: \(\Delta \mathbf{v} = \mathbf{0}\). Consequently, the average acceleration over one complete cycle is a null vector (\(\overline{\mathbf{a}} = \mathbf{0}\)), not a non-zero vector. Thus, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Evaluation of net acceleration in non-uniform circular motion
When the speed of a particle moving in a circle changes with time, the motion is non-uniform. The acceleration vector consists of two mutually perpendicular components:
1. Centripetal (radial) acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}_c = -\frac{v^2}{R}\,\hat{\mathbf{r}}\), perpendicular to the velocity and pointing toward the center.
2. Tangential acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}_t = \frac{dv}{dt}\,\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\), parallel to the velocity along the tangent.
Since \(\hat{\mathbf{r}} \cdot \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} = 0\), the magnitude of the resultant acceleration vector \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\) is determined by the Pythagorean relation:
\[ |\mathbf{a}| = \sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2} \]
Thus, the third statement is correct.

Conclusion
Centripetal force does zero work, average acceleration over one period is null, and total acceleration in non-uniform circular motion is \(\sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\). Therefore, Statement III only is correct.

चरण 1: अभिकेन्द्रीय बल द्वारा किए गए कार्य का मूल्यांकन
एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, अभिकेन्द्रीय बल \(\mathbf{F}_c\) वक्रता के तात्कालिक केंद्र की ओर त्रिज्यीय रूप से अंतर्मुखी होता है, जबकि अनंत सूक्ष्म विस्थापन \(d\mathbf{r}\) (और तात्कालिक वेग \(\mathbf{v}\)) वृत्त की स्पर्शरेखा के अनुदिश होता है। चूंकि त्रिज्या और स्पर्शरेखा प्रत्येक बिंदु पर परस्पर लंबवत होती हैं, अतः अदिश गुणनफल प्रत्येक क्षण शून्य होता है:
\[ dW = \mathbf{F}_c \cdot d\mathbf{r} = F_c \, ds \cos(90^\circ) = 0 \]
वृत्ताकार पथ के किसी भी सीमित खंड पर समाकलन करने पर कुल कार्य \(W = \int dW = 0\) प्राप्त होता है। अभिकेन्द्रीय बल कण पर कोई कार्य नहीं करता है। अतः पहला कथन गलत है।

चरण 2: एक पूर्ण आवर्तकाल में औसत त्वरण का मूल्यांकन
समय अंतराल \(T\) में औसत त्वरण की परिभाषा \(\overline{\mathbf{a}} = \frac{\Delta \mathbf{v}}{T} = \frac{\mathbf{v}(t + T) - \mathbf{v}(t)}{T}\) है। एकसमान वृत्तीय गति में, एक पूर्ण परिक्रमण (आवर्तकाल \(T\)) पूरा करने के बाद, कण उसी स्थिति में उसी चाल और उसी वेग दिशा के साथ वापस आ जाता है। इसलिए, एक पूरे चक्र में वेग सदिश में परिवर्तन ठीक शून्य होता है: \(\Delta \mathbf{v} = \mathbf{0}\)। परिणामस्वरूप, एक पूर्ण चक्र में औसत त्वरण एक शून्य सदिश (\(\overline{\mathbf{a}} = \mathbf{0}\)) होता है, न कि कोई शून्येतर सदिश। अतः दूसरा कथन गलत है।

चरण 3: असमान वृत्तीय गति में कुल त्वरण का मूल्यांकन
जब वृत्त में गतिमान कण की चाल समय के साथ बदलती है, तो गति असमान होती है। त्वरण सदिश के दो परस्पर लंबवत घटक होते हैं:
1. अभिकेन्द्रीय (त्रिज्यीय) त्वरण: \(\mathbf{a}_c = -\frac{v^2}{R}\,\hat{\mathbf{r}}\), जो वेग के लंबवत होता है और केंद्र की ओर इंगित करता है।
2. स्पर्शरेखीय त्वरण: \(\mathbf{a}_t = \frac{dv}{dt}\,\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\), जो स्पर्शरेखा के अनुदिश वेग के समानांतर होता है।
चूंकि \(\hat{\mathbf{r}} \cdot \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} = 0\) है, अतः परिणामी त्वरण सदिश \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}_c + \mathbf{a}_t\) का परिमाण पाइथागोरस संबंध द्वारा निर्धारित होता है:
\[ |\mathbf{a}| = \sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2} \]
अतः तीसरा कथन सही है।

निष्कर्ष
अभिकेन्द्रीय बल शून्य कार्य करता है, एक चक्र में औसत त्वरण शून्य सदिश होता है, और असमान वृत्तीय गति में कुल त्वरण \(\sqrt{a_c^2 + a_t^2}\) होता है। अतः, केवल कथन III सही है।

answer.text: Statement I, Statement II and Statement III are correct.
Statement I and Statement III only are correct.
Statement II and Statement III only are correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MATCH_LIST_Q01 - Classification and definitions of fundamental kinematic quantities

questiontext.text:
Match the items in List I with the corresponding descriptions or expressions in List II:

List I (Physical Quantity)List II (Definition and Dimension)
(A) Distance(I) Rate of change of velocity with dimensions \([\text{M}^0\text{L}\text{T}^{-2}]\)
(B) Velocity(II) Total path length traversed with SI unit metre
(C) Acceleration(III) Quantity of matter with dimensions \([\text{M}\text{L}^0\text{T}^0]\)
(D) Mass(IV) Rate of change of displacement with dimensions \([\text{M}^0\text{L}\text{T}^{-1}]\)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Matching for item (A) Distance
Distance is the scalar measure of the actual total path length traversed by an object during its motion between two points, having the SI unit of metre (\(\text{m}\)). Therefore, item (A) matches with entry II.

Step 2: Matching for item (B) Velocity
Velocity is defined as the time rate of change of displacement, which is a vector quantity having the dimensions of \([\text{M}^0\text{L}\text{T}^{-1}]\). Therefore, item (B) matches with entry IV.

Step 3: Matching for item (C) Acceleration
Acceleration is the time rate of change of velocity, which is a vector quantity with dimensions of \([\text{M}^0\text{L}\text{T}^{-2}]\). Therefore, item (C) matches with entry I.

Step 4: Matching for item (D) Mass
Mass is an intrinsic scalar property representing the quantity of matter within a body, having the base physical dimension of \([\text{M}\text{L}^0\text{T}^0]\). Therefore, item (D) matches with entry III.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
Combining all four evaluated pairings gives the complete correct match: A-II, B-IV, C-I, D-III.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MATCH_LIST_Q02 - Mathematical expressions governing parameters in projectile motion

questiontext.text:
Match the items in List I with the corresponding descriptions or expressions in List II:

List I (Projectile Parameter)List II (Mathematical Formula)
(A) Time of flight(I) \(\frac{v_0^2}{g}\)
(B) Maximum height(II) \(\frac{2v_0 \sin\theta_0}{g}\)
(C) Horizontal range(III) \(\frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta_0}{2g}\)
(D) Maximum horizontal range(IV) \(\frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta_0)}{g}\)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Matching for item (A) Time of flight
The total time during which a projectile remains in the air between launch and landing on level ground is derived by setting vertical displacement \(y = 0\): \(v_0 \sin\theta_0 t - \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0\), which yields \(T_f = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta_0}{g}\). Therefore, item (A) matches with entry II.

Step 2: Matching for item (B) Maximum height
At the apex of the trajectory, the vertical velocity component is zero (\(v_y = 0\)). Using \(v_y^2 = v_{0y}^2 - 2gh_m\) gives \(0 = (v_0 \sin\theta_0)^2 - 2gh_m\), hence \(h_m = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta_0}{2g}\). Therefore, item (B) matches with entry III.

Step 3: Matching for item (C) Horizontal range
The horizontal distance traveled during the time of flight is \(R = v_{0x} T_f = (v_0 \cos\theta_0)\left(\frac{2v_0 \sin\theta_0}{g}\right) = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta_0)}{g}\). Therefore, item (C) matches with entry IV.

Step 4: Matching for item (D) Maximum horizontal range
The range achieves its maximum value when the trigonometric factor \(\sin(2\theta_0) = 1\) (at \(\theta_0 = 45^\circ\)), giving \(R_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\). Therefore, item (D) matches with entry I.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
Combining all four evaluated pairings gives the complete correct match: A-II, B-III, C-IV, D-I.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MATCH_LIST_Q03 - Formulae relating parameters in uniform circular motion

questiontext.text:
Match the items in List I with the corresponding descriptions or expressions in List II:

List I (Circular Motion Variable)List II (Equivalent Relation)
(A) Angular speed in terms of linear speed(I) \(4\pi^2 \nu^2 R\)
(B) Centripetal acceleration in terms of angular speed(II) \(\frac{2\pi R}{T}\)
(C) Centripetal acceleration in terms of frequency(III) \(\frac{v}{R}\)
(D) Linear speed in terms of time period(IV) \(\omega^2 R\)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Matching for item (A) Angular speed in terms of linear speed
The linear speed along the circular path of radius \(R\) relates to the angular speed \(\omega\) by \(v = \omega R\). Solving for angular speed gives \(\omega = \frac{v}{R}\). Therefore, item (A) matches with entry III.

Step 2: Matching for item (B) Centripetal acceleration in terms of angular speed
The centripetal acceleration magnitude is \(a_c = \frac{v^2}{R}\). Substituting \(v = \omega R\) yields \(a_c = \frac{(\omega R)^2}{R} = \omega^2 R\). Therefore, item (B) matches with entry IV.

Step 3: Matching for item (C) Centripetal acceleration in terms of frequency
The angular speed is related to frequency of revolution \(\nu\) by \(\omega = 2\pi \nu\). Substituting into the centripetal acceleration formula gives \(a_c = \omega^2 R = (2\pi \nu)^2 R = 4\pi^2 \nu^2 R\). Therefore, item (C) matches with entry I.

Step 4: Matching for item (D) Linear speed in terms of time period
In one complete period \(T\), the particle travels a distance equal to the circumference \(2\pi R\). Hence, the speed is \(v = \frac{2\pi R}{T}\). Therefore, item (D) matches with entry II.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
Combining all four evaluated pairings gives the complete correct match: A-III, B-IV, C-I, D-II.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MATCH_LIST_Q04 - Resultant magnitude of equal vectors at various angles

questiontext.text:
Match the items in List I with the corresponding descriptions or expressions in List II:

List I (Angle between equal vectors of magnitude P)List II (Resultant Vector Magnitude)
(A) \(\theta = 0^\circ\)(I) \(\sqrt{3}\,P\)
(B) \(\theta = 60^\circ\)(II) \(\sqrt{2}\,P\)
(C) \(\theta = 90^\circ\)(III) \(P\)
(D) \(\theta = 120^\circ\)(IV) \(2P\)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Governing Formula for Resultant of Two Equal Vectors
For two vectors of equal magnitude \(P\) inclined at an angle \(\theta\), the law of cosines gives the resultant magnitude: \(R = \sqrt{P^2 + P^2 + 2P^2\cos\theta} = \sqrt{2P^2(1 + \cos\theta)} = \sqrt{4P^2 \cos^2(\theta/2)} = 2P\cos(\theta/2)\).

Step 2: Matching for item (A) at angle 0 degrees
When \(\theta = 0^\circ\), \(\cos(0^\circ/2) = \cos(0^\circ) = 1\), which yields \(R = 2P(1) = 2P\). Therefore, item (A) matches with entry IV.

Step 3: Matching for item (B) at angle 60 degrees
When \(\theta = 60^\circ\), \(\cos(60^\circ/2) = \cos(30^\circ) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), which yields \(R = 2P\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = \sqrt{3}\,P\). Therefore, item (B) matches with entry I.

Step 4: Matching for item (C) at angle 90 degrees
When \(\theta = 90^\circ\), \(\cos(90^\circ/2) = \cos(45^\circ) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), which yields \(R = 2P\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right) = \sqrt{2}\,P\). Therefore, item (C) matches with entry II.

Step 5: Matching for item (D) at angle 120 degrees
When \(\theta = 120^\circ\), \(\cos(120^\circ/2) = \cos(60^\circ) = \frac{1}{2}\), which yields \(R = 2P\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = P\). Therefore, item (D) matches with entry III.

Step 6: Final Conclusion
Combining all four evaluated pairings gives the complete correct match: A-IV, B-I, C-II, D-III.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q01 - Resultant magnitude of two perpendicular vectors

questiontext.text: Two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) have magnitudes of \(6\text{ N}\) and \(8\text{ N}\) respectively and act at right angles to each other (\(\theta = 90^\circ\)). The magnitude of their resultant vector is:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The magnitudes of the two vectors are \(A = 6\text{ N}\) and \(B = 8\text{ N}\). The angle between them is \(\theta = 90^\circ\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
According to the parallelogram law of vector addition, the magnitude \(R\) of the resultant of two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) inclined at an angle \(\theta\) is given by: \[R = \sqrt{A^2 + B^2 + 2AB\cos\theta}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values into the resultant formula: \[R = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2 + 2(6)(8)\cos 90^\circ}\] Since \(\cos 90^\circ = 0\), the cross-term vanishes: \[R = \sqrt{36 + 64 + 0} = \sqrt{100} = 10\text{ N}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
For two perpendicular vectors, the resultant magnitude corresponds to the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle with sides \(6\text{ N}\) and \(8\text{ N}\). Since \(6^2 + 8^2 = 10^2\), the calculation is physically and mathematically consistent.
Therefore, the correct magnitude is \(10\text{ N}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q02 - Magnitude of a two dimensional vector

questiontext.text: A displacement vector in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane is given by \(\mathbf{r} = 3\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{j}}\text{ m}\). What is the magnitude of this displacement vector?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The components of the displacement vector \(\mathbf{r} = r_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + r_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) are \(r_x = 3\text{ m}\) and \(r_y = 4\text{ m}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnitude of a vector specified in terms of rectangular Cartesian components in a plane is given by: \[|\mathbf{r}| = \sqrt{r_x^2 + r_y^2}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting the components: \[|\mathbf{r}| = \sqrt{(3\text{ m})^2 + (4\text{ m})^2} = \sqrt{9 + 16}\text{ m} = \sqrt{25}\text{ m} = 5\text{ m}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The components form a standard 3-4-5 right triangle. The calculated length is strictly positive and matches the Pythagorean length.
Therefore, the correct magnitude is \(5\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q03 - Angle of a vector with coordinate axis

questiontext.text: A force vector is given by \(\mathbf{F} = (\sqrt{3}\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 1\,\hat{\mathbf{j}})\text{ N}\). What angle \(\theta\) does this vector make with the positive \(x\)-axis?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The vector components are \(F_x = \sqrt{3}\text{ N}\) along the positive \(x\)-axis and \(F_y = 1\text{ N}\) along the positive \(y\)-axis.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The angle \(\theta\) that a vector \(\mathbf{F} = F_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + F_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) makes with the positive \(x\)-axis satisfies: \[\tan\theta = \frac{F_y}{F_x}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given rectangular components: \[\tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\] In the first quadrant (where both \(F_x > 0\) and \(F_y > 0\)), the primary angle whose tangent is \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) is: \[\theta = \arctan\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = 30^\circ\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Since \(F_x > F_y > 0\), the vector lies closer to the \(x\)-axis than the \(y\)-axis, confirming that \(\theta < 45^\circ\). The value \(30^\circ\) is completely consistent.
Therefore, the correct angle is \(30^\circ\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q04 - Horizontal velocity component of a projectile

questiontext.text: A ball is thrown with an initial speed of \(40\text{ m/s}\) at an angle of \(60^\circ\) above the horizontal. What is the horizontal component of its initial velocity?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The initial projection speed is \(v_0 = 40\text{ m/s}\) and the projection angle with the horizontal is \(\theta = 60^\circ\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal component of the initial velocity vector is obtained by resolving along the horizontal axis: \[v_{0x} = v_0 \cos\theta\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values: \[v_{0x} = 40\cos 60^\circ = 40 \times \frac{1}{2} = 20\text{ m/s}\]

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q05 - Centripetal acceleration in uniform circular motion

questiontext.text: A particle moves along a circular path of radius \(R = 5\text{ m}\) with a constant speed of \(v = 10\text{ m/s}\). The magnitude of its centripetal acceleration is:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The radius of the circular path is \(R = 5\text{ m}\) and the uniform speed is \(v = 10\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
In uniform circular motion, the acceleration is directed radially inward towards the centre (centripetal acceleration) with magnitude: \[a_c = \frac{v^2}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values into the formula: \[a_c = \frac{(10\text{ m/s})^2}{5\text{ m}} = \frac{100}{5}\text{ m/s}^2 = 20\text{ m/s}^2\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The unit is \(\text{m}^2/\text{s}^2 / \text{m} = \text{m/s}^2\), which matches the dimensional units of acceleration.
Therefore, the centripetal acceleration is \(20\text{ m/s}^2\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q06 - Maximum range of a projectile on level ground

questiontext.text: A stone is projected from level ground with an initial speed of \(14\text{ m/s}\). Taking the acceleration due to gravity as \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\), the maximum horizontal range achievable by the stone is:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The launch speed is \(v_0 = 14\text{ m/s}\) and \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal range of a projectile launched at an angle \(\theta\) on level ground is: \[R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\] The range is maximum when \(\sin 2\theta = 1\) (i.e. \(\theta = 45^\circ\)), giving: \[R_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values: \[R_{\max} = \frac{(14\text{ m/s})^2}{9.8\text{ m/s}^2} = \frac{196}{9.8}\text{ m} = 20\text{ m}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Since \(196 / 9.8 = 20\text{ m}\), the calculation is exact and units check out correctly.
Therefore, the maximum horizontal range is \(20\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q07 - Period of revolution in circular motion

questiontext.text: A particle executes uniform circular motion with a rotational frequency of \(120\text{ revolutions per minute (rpm)}\). What is the time period of one complete revolution?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The rotational frequency is \(\nu = 120\text{ rpm}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Convert frequency from revolutions per minute to revolutions per second (Hertz): \[\nu = \frac{120}{60}\text{ rev/s} = 2\text{ rev/s} = 2\text{ Hz}\] The time period \(T\) is the reciprocal of frequency: \[T = \frac{1}{\nu}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the frequency: \[T = \frac{1}{2\text{ s}^{-1}} = 0.5\text{ s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
If 2 full revolutions take 1 second, then each single revolution takes exactly 0.5 seconds.
Therefore, the correct time period is \(0.5\text{ s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q08 - Resultant speed of rain falling in horizontal wind

questiontext.text: Rain is falling vertically with a speed of \(35\text{ m/s}\). A wind starts blowing after some time with a speed of \(12\text{ m/s}\) in east to west direction. What is the magnitude of the resultant velocity of the raindrops?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The vertical velocity of rain is \(v_r = 35\text{ m/s}\) (downwards). The horizontal velocity of wind is \(v_w = 12\text{ m/s}\) (east to west).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The vertical direction and horizontal direction are orthogonal (\(\theta = 90^\circ\)). The velocity of rain relative to the ground is the vector sum \(\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{v}_r + \mathbf{v}_w\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnitude of the resultant velocity of two perpendicular vectors is: \[v = \sqrt{v_r^2 + v_w^2}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given speeds: \[v = \sqrt{35^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{1225 + 144} = \sqrt{1369} = 37\text{ m/s}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Checking the square: \(37^2 = 1369\). The resultant speed is greater than both individual components and matches the Pythagorean triplet (12, 35, 37).
Therefore, the resultant speed of the raindrops is \(37\text{ m/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q09 - Angle of umbrella protection against slanted rain

questiontext.text: Rain is falling vertically with a speed of \(35\text{ m/s}\), and wind is blowing from east to west with a speed of \(12\text{ m/s}\). In which direction should a boy waiting at a bus stop hold his umbrella to protect himself from the rain?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Vertical speed of rain: \(v_r = 35\text{ m/s}\) downward. Horizontal speed of wind: \(v_w = 12\text{ m/s}\) towards the west.

Step 2: Physical Principle and Umbrella Orientation
The falling raindrops acquire a horizontal velocity towards the west due to the wind, so the rain approaches from the east towards the west. To protect against the oncoming raindrops, the umbrella must be tilted into the direction from which the rain is coming, i.e. towards the east, at an angle \(\theta\) with the vertical.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The angle \(\theta\) made by the resultant velocity of rain with the vertical is: \[\tan\theta = \frac{v_w}{v_r}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the tangent of the angle: \[\tan\theta = \frac{12}{35} \approx 0.3429\] Taking the arctangent: \[\theta = \arctan(0.3429) \approx 18.9^\circ \approx 19^\circ\] Because the wind blows towards the west, the rain arrives inclined from the east. Hence, the umbrella must be tilted towards the east.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The calculated angle is roughly \(19^\circ\) with the vertical, oriented towards the east to oppose the incoming rain direction.
Therefore, the umbrella should be held at approximately \(19^\circ\) with the vertical, tilted towards the east.

answer.text: At an angle of \(\approx 19^\circ\) with the vertical, tilted towards the east
At an angle of \(\approx 19^\circ\) with the vertical, tilted towards the west
At an angle of \(\approx 30^\circ\) with the vertical, tilted towards the east
At an angle of \(\approx 30^\circ\) with the vertical, tilted towards the west

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q10 - Maximum height reached by a cricket ball

questiontext.text: A cricket ball is hit with an initial speed of \(28\text{ m/s}\) at an angle of \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Taking \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\), what is the maximum height reached by the ball?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial speed \(v_0 = 28\text{ m/s}\), launch angle \(\theta = 30^\circ\), and acceleration due to gravity \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The maximum height \(h_{\max}\) attained by a projectile above the launch level is given by: \[h_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
First, calculate the vertical component of the initial velocity: \[v_{0y} = v_0 \sin 30^\circ = 28 \times 0.5 = 14\text{ m/s}\] Substitute \(v_{0y}\) and \(g\) into the maximum height formula: \[h_{\max} = \frac{(14\text{ m/s})^2}{2 \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2} = \frac{196}{19.6}\text{ m} = 10.0\text{ m}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The fraction \(196 / 19.6\) evaluates exactly to \(10.0\text{ m}\).
Therefore, the maximum height reached by the ball is \(10.0\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q11 - Time of flight of a cricket ball

questiontext.text: A cricket ball is thrown with an initial speed of \(28\text{ m/s}\) at an angle of \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Taking \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\), the total time taken by the ball to return to the same level is:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial speed \(v_0 = 28\text{ m/s}\), launch angle \(\theta = 30^\circ\), and \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The total time of flight \(T_f\) for a projectile returning to its launch elevation is: \[T_f = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Evaluate the numerator: \[2v_0 \sin\theta = 2 \times 28 \times \sin 30^\circ = 56 \times 0.5 = 28\text{ m/s}\] Now divide by the acceleration due to gravity: \[T_f = \frac{28}{9.8} = \frac{280}{98} = \frac{20}{7} \approx 2.857\text{ s} \approx 2.86\text{ s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The time to reach maximum height is \(v_{0y}/g = 14/9.8 = 10/7 \approx 1.43\text{ s}\). The total flight time is double this ascent time, \(2 \times 1.43\text{ s} = 2.86\text{ s}\).
Therefore, the total time of flight is approximately \(2.86\text{ s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q12 - Horizontal range of a projectile cricket ball

questiontext.text: A cricket ball is hit with a velocity of \(28\text{ m/s}\) at an angle of \(30^\circ\) with the horizontal. The horizontal distance from the thrower to the point where the ball returns to the same level is: (Take \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial velocity \(v_0 = 28\text{ m/s}\), angle \(\theta = 30^\circ\), and \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal range \(R\) on level ground is given by: \[R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given parameters: \[R = \frac{(28)^2 \sin(2 \times 30^\circ)}{9.8} = \frac{784 \sin 60^\circ}{9.8}\] Since \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx 0.8660\): \[R = \frac{784 \times 0.8660}{9.8} = 80 \times 0.8660 = 69.28\text{ m} \approx 69.3\text{ m}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Alternatively, using \(R = v_{0x} \times T_f\): \[R = (28\cos 30^\circ) \times \left(\frac{20}{7}\right) = \left(28 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) \times \frac{20}{7} = 14\sqrt{3} \times \frac{20}{7} = 40\sqrt{3} \approx 40 \times 1.732 = 69.28\text{ m} \approx 69.3\text{ m}\] Both methods agree perfectly.
Therefore, the horizontal distance is \(69.3\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q13 - Time of fall for horizontally projected stone

questiontext.text: A stone is thrown horizontally with an initial velocity of \(15\text{ m/s}\) from the top of a cliff of height \(490\text{ m}\). Taking \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\), how long does it take for the stone to reach the ground?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Height of cliff \(h = 490\text{ m}\), initial horizontal velocity \(v_{0x} = 15\text{ m/s}\), initial vertical velocity \(v_{0y} = 0\), and acceleration due to gravity \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
Horizontal and vertical motions are independent. The time to reach the ground depends solely on the vertical displacement and vertical acceleration under gravity.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The equation for vertical displacement from rest is: \[h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 \implies t = \sqrt{\frac{2h}{g}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the values: \[t = \sqrt{\frac{2 \times 490\text{ m}}{9.8\text{ m/s}^2}} = \sqrt{\frac{980}{9.8}}\text{ s} = \sqrt{100}\text{ s} = 10\text{ s}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The horizontal projection velocity does not alter the vertical acceleration or vertical fall time.
Therefore, the time taken to reach the ground is \(10\text{ s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q14 - Impact speed of a horizontally thrown stone

questiontext.text: A stone is thrown horizontally with a velocity of \(15\text{ m/s}\) from the top of a cliff \(490\text{ m}\) high. Taking \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\), what is the speed with which the stone strikes the ground?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Cliff height \(h = 490\text{ m}\), initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}_0 = 15\hat{\mathbf{i}}\text{ m/s}\), and \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal component of velocity remains constant throughout the flight: \[v_x = v_{0x} = 15\text{ m/s}\] The vertical component of velocity just before impact is obtained from: \[v_y^2 = 2gh \implies v_y = \sqrt{2gh}\] The total striking speed is: \[v = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the vertical velocity component: \[v_y = \sqrt{2 \times 9.8 \times 490} = \sqrt{9604} = 98\text{ m/s}\] Now combine both components: \[v = \sqrt{15^2 + 98^2} = \sqrt{225 + 9604} = \sqrt{9829} \approx 99.14\text{ m/s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Since the vertical speed (\(98\text{ m/s}\)) is much larger than the horizontal speed (\(15\text{ m/s}\)), the resultant speed must be slightly greater than \(98\text{ m/s}\), which is verified by \(99.1\text{ m/s}\).
Therefore, the impact speed is approximately \(99.1\text{ m/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q15 - Angular speed of insect in circular groove

questiontext.text: An insect trapped in a circular groove of radius \(12\text{ cm}\) moves steadily along the groove and completes \(7\) revolutions in \(100\text{ s}\). Taking \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\), what is the angular speed of the motion?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius \(R = 12\text{ cm}\), number of revolutions \(N = 7\), time elapsed \(t = 100\text{ s}\), and \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Each complete revolution corresponds to an angular displacement of \(2\pi\text{ radians}\). Total angular displacement is: \[\theta = 2\pi N\] The angular speed \(\omega\) is given by: \[\omega = \frac{\theta}{t} = \frac{2\pi N}{t}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given numbers: \[\omega = \frac{2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7}{100} = \frac{2 \times 22}{100} = \frac{44}{100} = 0.44\text{ rad/s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The factor of 7 cancels cleanly between the numerator and denominator, giving exactly \(0.44\text{ rad/s}\).
Therefore, the angular speed is \(0.44\text{ rad/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q16 - Linear speed of insect in circular groove

questiontext.text: An insect trapped in a circular groove of radius \(12\text{ cm}\) completes \(7\) revolutions in \(100\text{ s}\). What is the linear speed of the insect? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius \(R = 12\text{ cm}\), angular speed \(\omega = 0.44\text{ rad/s}\) (from \(7\) revolutions in \(100\text{ s}\) with \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\)).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The relation between linear speed \(v\) and angular speed \(\omega\) in circular motion is: \[v = \omega R\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the values: \[v = 0.44\text{ rad/s} \times 12\text{ cm} = 5.28\text{ cm/s} \approx 5.3\text{ cm/s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Alternatively, the total distance travelled is \(7 \times 2\pi R = 7 \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 12 = 528\text{ cm}\). Dividing by the time of \(100\text{ s}\) gives \(v = \frac{528}{100} = 5.28\text{ cm/s} \approx 5.3\text{ cm/s}\).
Therefore, the linear speed is \(5.3\text{ cm/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q17 - Centripetal acceleration of insect in circular groove

questiontext.text: An insect moves steadily in a circular groove of radius \(12\text{ cm}\) with an angular speed of \(0.44\text{ rad/s}\). What is the magnitude of the centripetal acceleration of the insect?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius \(R = 12\text{ cm}\) and angular speed \(\omega = 0.44\text{ rad/s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The centripetal acceleration \(a_c\) in circular motion is expressed in terms of angular speed as: \[a_c = \omega^2 R\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate \(\omega^2\): \[\omega^2 = (0.44)^2 = 0.1936\text{ rad}^2/\text{s}^2\] Multiply by the radius: \[a_c = 0.1936 \times 12 = 2.3232\text{ cm/s}^2 \approx 2.3\text{ cm/s}^2\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Using \(a_c = v^2/R\) with \(v = 5.28\text{ cm/s}\): \[a_c = \frac{(5.28)^2}{12} = \frac{27.8784}{12} = 2.3232\text{ cm/s}^2 \approx 2.3\text{ cm/s}^2\] Both formulations yield identical values.
Therefore, the centripetal acceleration is \(2.3\text{ cm/s}^2\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q18 - Resultant of two equal vectors at an angle

questiontext.text: Two forces of equal magnitude \(F\) act on a point particle at an angle of \(120^\circ\) to each other. What is the magnitude of their resultant force?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two forces have magnitudes \(|\mathbf{F}_1| = |\mathbf{F}_2| = F\) and are inclined at an angle \(\theta = 120^\circ\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnitude of the resultant \(R\) of two vectors is: \[R = \sqrt{F_1^2 + F_2^2 + 2F_1 F_2 \cos\theta}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the equal magnitudes and the angle: \[R = \sqrt{F^2 + F^2 + 2(F)(F)\cos 120^\circ}\] Since \(\cos 120^\circ = -\frac{1}{2}\): \[R = \sqrt{2F^2 + 2F^2\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)} = \sqrt{2F^2 - F^2} = \sqrt{F^2} = F\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
When two equal vectors are separated by \(120^\circ\), they form an equilateral triangle with their negative resultant, meaning the resultant has the exact same magnitude as each individual vector.
Therefore, the magnitude of the resultant force is \(F\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q19 - Centripetal acceleration of an aircraft in a loop

questiontext.text: An aircraft executes a horizontal loop of radius \(1.00\text{ km}\) with a steady speed of \(900\text{ km/h}\). The ratio of its centripetal acceleration to the acceleration due to gravity \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\) is approximately:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius of the loop \(R = 1.00\text{ km} = 1000\text{ m}\), speed \(v = 900\text{ km/h}\), and \(g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2\).

Step 2: Unit Conversion and Principles
Convert speed from \(\text{km/h}\) to \(\text{m/s}\): \[v = 900 \times \frac{5}{18} = 50 \times 5 = 250\text{ m/s}\] Centripetal acceleration in a circular turn is: \[a_c = \frac{v^2}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Compute the centripetal acceleration: \[a_c = \frac{(250\text{ m/s})^2}{1000\text{ m}} = \frac{62500}{1000}\text{ m/s}^2 = 62.5\text{ m/s}^2\] Now evaluate the ratio \(a_c / g\): \[\frac{a_c}{g} = \frac{62.5\text{ m/s}^2}{9.8\text{ m/s}^2} \approx 6.3776 \approx 6.38\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Checking: \(6.38 \times 9.8 = 62.524\text{ m/s}^2\), which matches \(62.5\text{ m/s}^2\).
Therefore, the ratio of the centripetal acceleration to gravity is approximately \(6.38\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q20 - Magnitude of resultant of two vector expressions

questiontext.text: Two vectors are given by \(\mathbf{A} = 2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = 4\hat{\mathbf{i}} - 5\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). What is the magnitude of the resultant vector \(\mathbf{R} = \mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}\)?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The given vectors are \(\mathbf{A} = 2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = 4\hat{\mathbf{i}} - 5\hat{\mathbf{j}}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Vector addition in component form adds corresponding components: \[\mathbf{R} = (A_x + B_x)\hat{\mathbf{i}} + (A_y + B_y)\hat{\mathbf{j}}\] Its magnitude is: \[|\mathbf{R}| = \sqrt{R_x^2 + R_y^2}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Add the components: \[R_x = 2 + 4 = 6\] \[R_y = 3 + (-5) = -2\] So the resultant vector is \(\mathbf{R} = 6\hat{\mathbf{i}} - 2\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Calculate the magnitude: \[|\mathbf{R}| = \sqrt{6^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{36 + 4} = \sqrt{40} = \sqrt{4 \times 10} = 2\sqrt{10}\text{ units}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Numerically, \(2\sqrt{10} \approx 6.32\text{ units}\). The expression is in simplest radical form.
Therefore, the magnitude of the resultant vector is \(2\sqrt{10}\text{ units}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MOTION_IN_A_PLANE_MCQ_Q21 - Speed of a particle from position time function

questiontext.text: The position of a particle is given by \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3.0t\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 2.0t^2\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 5.0\,\hat{\mathbf{k}}\), where \(t\) is in seconds and \(\mathbf{r}\) is in metres. What is the magnitude of its velocity at \(t = 1.0\text{ s}\)?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The time-dependent position vector is \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3.0t\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 2.0t^2\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 5.0\,\hat{\mathbf{k}}\). We seek the speed at \(t = 1.0\text{ s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Velocity is the first time derivative of position: \[\mathbf{v}(t) = \frac{\mathrm{d}\mathbf{r}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(3.0t)\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(2.0t^2)\hat{\mathbf{j}} + \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(5.0)\hat{\mathbf{k}}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Differentiate each component with respect to time: \[\mathbf{v}(t) = 3.0\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 4.0t\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 0\,\hat{\mathbf{k}}\] Evaluate the velocity vector at \(t = 1.0\text{ s}\): \[\mathbf{v}(1.0) = 3.0\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 4.0(1.0)\,\hat{\mathbf{j}} = 3.0\,\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 4.0\,\hat{\mathbf{j}}\text{ m/s}\] Compute the magnitude (speed): \[v = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2} = \sqrt{(3.0)^2 + (4.0)^2} = \sqrt{9 + 16} = \sqrt{25} = 5.0\text{ m/s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The constant \(z\)-component contributes zero velocity. The \(x\) and \(y\) components form a classic 3-4-5 right triangle.
Therefore, the magnitude of the velocity at \(t = 1.0\text{ s}\) is \(5.0\text{ m/s}\).
